description.zh:
需要删除配置的加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，注意以下配置限制：

- 一次最多传20个域名。
- 域名个数乘以 FunctionNames个数，小于等于50。
description.en:
The accelerated domain names whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). Note the following limits:

- You can specify up to 20 domain names in each request.

- The number of domain names multiplied by the number of feature names cannot exceed 50.

description.zh: 需要删除的功能函数名称，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次传入最多50个。更多功能名称，请参见[域名配置功能参数](~~388460~~)。
description.en: The feature names that you want to delete. Separate multiple feature names with a comma (,). You can specify up to 50 feature names in each request. For more information, see [Parameters for configuring features for domain names](~~388460~~).

descriptions.en: - The call frequency is limited to 30 calls per second per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn batch-delete-cdn-domain-config --domain-names example.com,example.org --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
